content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can establish a fully functional online store within 48 hours using blockchain technology. Start by setting up a digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This infrastructure empowers you to serve international clients and bypasses the limitations imposed by conventional payment platforms. With a focus on automation and ease of use, you can launch your digital products within days.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack consists of several key components: a hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend solution (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), a payment processor (NOWPayments), and a storage solution (Supabase or Google Sheets). This stack enables you to create a reliable and scalable digital store. By using USDT on the Tron network, your transactions settle in under 60 seconds with fees below $0.10, ensuring a smooth experience for both you and your customers.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on deploying the essential components of your digital store first. Avoid getting bogged down in advanced features or aesthetics when you can simply get your products online and start selling. Concentrate on setting up your payment processing with NOWPayments and ensuring your product files are ready for delivery. Additional features, such as marketing tools or complex order management systems, can come later once you confirm that the basic stack is operational.
Accept payments in under 60 seconds with fees below $0.10 using USDT on Tron.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To initiate your first transaction, prepare a product to sell and load it into your digital store. Ensure that NOWPayments is correctly integrated and configured to handle incoming payments. Test the payment process using a small transaction, verifying that funds settle swiftly and accurately. This initial live transaction will not only build your confidence but will also provide valuable insights into the customer experience, allowing you to refine your processes as needed.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, finalize your product offerings and complete your store setup. Register for NOWPayments and connect it to your store. Create an account on Binance P2P to facilitate local currency transactions for your customers. Begin marketing your digital products through social media channels to attract buyers. Take proactive steps to ensure your infrastructure is robust and ready to handle incoming sales.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Your infrastructure is yours—no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies using NOWPayments, allowing flexibility and catering to a global audience. This includes popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT.
How do I ensure my transactions are secure?
Using blockchain technology for payments guarantees the security of transactions. With NOWPayments, every payment is verified on-chain, ensuring that your funds are protected from fraud.
Can I use local currencies for transactions?
Yes, platforms like Binance P2P allow you to convert cryptocurrencies into local currencies such as Bangladeshi Taka, making it easier for you to transact in your preferred currency.
Is there ongoing support after setup?
Yes, you will have access to a 30-day support period after deploying your stack. This ensures you have assistance as you navigate initial transactions and scaling your digital store.
What if I need more than just a basic setup?
If you require advanced features, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers extensive resources, including additional templates and blueprints to help you expand your digital commerce capabilities.
